Red Embroidered Bodice by the Sea

Earthy, windswept, timeless
WORKING NOTES
- The red embroidery against the cream blouse is the defining contrast.
- Keep the overcast sky to maintain the muted palette.
Try this: Keep the overcast sky for a muted palette.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with dark brown hair in a
loose side braid, with strands blowing across her
face, wears a red embroidered high-necked bodice
over a white gathered blouse with puff sleeves.
Red ribbon ties hang from her shoulders, and gold
drop earrings catch the light. She stands on a
windswept shoreline under an overcast sky. Her
expression is steady and serious. Soft, muted
daylight, a palette of crimson, cream, and sandy
gold. Timeless and windswept, in the style of a film
photograph.
